import glob,pickle,time
for tf in (\"4h\",\"1h\"):
    for sym in (\"BTCUSDT\",\"ETHUSDT\",\"SOLUSDT\"):
        f=sorted(glob.glob(\"/opt/trading-bot/wfscan/cache/*_%s_%s.pkl\"%(sym,tf)))[-1]
        d=pickle.load(open(f,\"rb\")).sort_values(\"t\")
        n=len(d); cut=int(n*0.7)
        t=lambda i: time.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\",time.gmtime(d.t.iloc[i]/1000))
        print(tf,sym,t(0),\"->\",t(cut),\"->\",t(n-1),\"| %%: search\",round((d.c.iloc[cut]/d.c.iloc[0]-1)*100),\"holdout\",round((d.c.iloc[-1]/d.c.iloc[cut]-1)*100),\"total\",round((d.c.iloc[-1]/d.c.iloc[0]-1)*100))
